browser.description: Inspect Browser Lab status, operation manifest, audit records, run URL policy preflight, execute the P0 acceptance smoke, or run an admin local-dev smoke.

url.description: Policy preflight URL or acceptance smoke target URL. Defaults to MAVERICK_BROWSER_ACCEPTANCE_URL or https://example.com/ for acceptance.smoke.

app_id.description: Local app id for dev.smoke; used to build /app/<app_id>/<path> on hostmachine.

path.description: Optional app page path for dev.smoke, without scheme, query, or fragment.

port.description: Allowlisted hostmachine admin dev target port for dev.smoke. Defaults to MAVERICK_BROWSER_DEV_SMOKE_PORT or 8000.

mobile.description: Use mobile browser context defaults for smoke/session creation when viewport dimensions are omitted.
